Identity.Name: Pset_StingCoordination
Identity.Definition: STING coordination and model-quality state - element revision, clash triage, as-built capture, ACC issue link and model health score. Carried in a STING-owned set because none of these is a buildingSMART property (DSCH-38).

Governance.StandardsBasis: ISO 19650-2:2018 information container revision; STING clash triage (V6 ClashTriageEngine); Autodesk Construction Cloud Issues; STING model health dashboard

Property.name: Revision
Property.Definition: Current revision code (display label, GROUP 1). See also ASS_REV_COD_TXT (GROUP 17) for the ISO 19650 tag container token. STING parameter ASS_REV_TXT. DSCH-38: moved here from Pset_ConstructionOperation.Revision, a property buildingSMART does not define (the Pset_ prefix is reserved for sets the IFC specification declares).

Property.name: ClashSeverity
Property.Definition: Clash triage severity 1 (lowest) to 5 (highest). STING parameter CLASH_TRIAGE_SEVERITY_NR. DSCH-38: moved here from Pset_ConstructionOperation.ClashSeverity, a property buildingSMART does not define (the Pset_ prefix is reserved for sets the IFC specification declares).

Property.name: ClashResolutionStatus
Property.Definition: Clash resolution status (PENDING / APPLIED / ACCEPTED). STING parameter CLASH_RESOLUTION_STATUS_TXT. DSCH-38: moved here from Pset_ConstructionOperation.ClashResolutionStatus, a property buildingSMART does not define (the Pset_ prefix is reserved for sets the IFC specification declares).

Property.name: AsBuiltDeviation
Property.Definition: As-built vs as-designed deviation in millimetres. STING parameter ASBUILT_DEVIATION_MM. DSCH-38: moved here from Pset_ConstructionOperation.AsBuiltDeviation, a property buildingSMART does not define (the Pset_ prefix is reserved for sets the IFC specification declares).

Property.name: AsBuiltCaptureDate
Property.Definition: ISO 8601 date when as-built data captured from Planscape mobile. STING parameter ASBUILT_CAPTURE_DATE_TXT. DSCH-38: moved here from Pset_ConstructionOperation.AsBuiltCaptureDate, a property buildingSMART does not define (the Pset_ prefix is reserved for sets the IFC specification declares).

Property.name: ACCIssueId
Property.Definition: Autodesk Construction Cloud Issue GUID for bidirectional sync. STING parameter ACC_ISSUE_ID_TXT. DSCH-38: moved here from Pset_ConstructionOperation.ACCIssueId, a property buildingSMART does not define (the Pset_ prefix is reserved for sets the IFC specification declares).

Property.name: ModelHealthScore
Property.Definition: Last model health score 0 to 100. STING parameter HEALTH_SCORE_LAST_NR. DSCH-38: moved here from Pset_ConstructionOperation.ModelHealthScore, a property buildingSMART does not define (the Pset_ prefix is reserved for sets the IFC specification declares).
